text: Darrud (Persian: درود) is a city located in the Central District of Zeberkhan County, Razavi Khorasan province, Iran. During the 2006 National Census, the city had a population of 4,979 people living in 1,431 households, at the time when it was part of the former Zeberkhan District within Nishapur County. The 2011 census recorded a population of 5,449 individuals in 1,618 households. In the 2016 census, the population was reported as 5,717 people residing in 1,846 households. Following the census, the district was separated from the county to establish Zeberkhan County, and as a result, Darrud was transferred to the newly formed Central District.
